description: This file defines the EmergencyContact Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project. The class is used to fetch and normalize emergency contact information for an employee, given their employee number. It includes methods to convert data to an array based on specified fields and to map field names to corresponding getter methods.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: A DTO class used to retrieve and normalize emergency contact data for a specific employee based on their employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmergencyContact DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the employee's emergency contacts filtered by specified fields, utilizing normalization.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods from the Employee entity.
